body.title: Add the legacy feedback conversion
body.summary: Add the pure conversion from a stored FeedbackEntry to a Feedback with a report of unmapped fields: absent kind becomes comment, the author becomes an unknown: actor, sectionSlug becomes section, the segment becomes lines, an integer target.version becomes revision and any other value is reported, and the decision becomes the batch's log outcome.
acceptanceChecks: every stated mapping is covered by a test including the absent kind and the namespaced actor
an unmappable target.version or a foreign target.file is reported, not dropped

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/feedback-convert.test.ts: the legacy feedback conversion maps every field and reports what it cannot map
